Container.Name: ap-discord-bot
Container.Overview:
Discord bot for Archipelago multiworld games.
- Lists games and open sign-ups, and joins sign-up rounds from Discord - Live threads and roles per game, with opt-in direct messages for items, hints and stuck players - Player tools from Discord: tracker, hints, release, collect, hand-over of slots
It talks to a running Archipelago Manager over its REST API, so the manager must be reachable from this container: put both containers on the same custom Docker network and use http://ArchipelagoManager:8080, or use http://[Unraid IP]:8080 (the API token then crosses your network unencrypted). The bot has no web UI.
Container.Requires: A running Archipelago Manager (ghcr.io/niklaskodev/archipelagomanagerdocker) and a Discord application

Config.Name: Data (appdata)
Config.Description: SQLite database and heartbeat. Back this folder up together with the encryption key.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: The bot token of your Discord application (Discord developer portal, Bot, Reset Token).

Config.Name: Manager address
Config.Description: Address of the manager without a path, as this container sees it: http://ArchipelagoManager:8080 when both containers are on the same custom Docker network, otherwise http://<Unraid IP>:8080. Use https:// anywhere but a private Docker network; see the README.

Config.Name: Manager API token
Config.Description: API token (starts with apm_) of the bot's account on the manager: a plain user, access Read. Create it in the manager under API tokens.

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Encrypts the manager tokens people link with /link. One or more Fernet keys separated by commas, the first one encrypts. Make one with: docker run --rm ghcr.io/niklaskodev/archipelagodiscordbot python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())" Lose it and everyone has to link again.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL.

Config.Name: Development server id
Config.Description: Development only: register the commands in this one Discord server instead of globally. Leave empty.

Config.Name: Data folder in the container
Config.Description: Leave at /data; it must match the container path of 'Data (appdata)'.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the bot runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the bot runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: For example Europe/Berlin. Affects timestamps in the log.
